hook_decisions_schema_valid.mechanism: every emitted HookEventEnvelope carries exactly the schema required keys with additionalProperties false, canonical vocabulary, and sha256 hash patterns; a timeout, callback rejection, or invalid callback output becomes a sealed ERROR envelope (HOOK_DECISION_TIMEOUT / HOOK_DECISION_CALLBACK_ERROR / HOOK_DECISION_INVALID) rather than being coerced to ALLOW, and a tampered envelope is rejected with HOOK_ENVELOPE_HASH_MISMATCH or HOOK_ENVELOPE_INVALID

host_payloads_hash_and_normalize.mechanism: the raw host payload is asserted canonical JSON, rejected with NON_CANONICAL_JSON on cycles, sparse or accessor-backed arrays, Proxies, BigInt, NaN, -0, Infinity, lone surrogates, or prototype-polluted and symbol-keyed objects before the decision callback runs, hashed under sha256:<hex>, and cloned into a frozen normalized_payload with sorted keys so insertion order cannot change either hash
